company.name: C2FO
company.shortDescription: The world’s on-demand working capital platform, providing fast & flexible access to low-cost capital to nearly 2 million businesses.
company.description:
C2FO is the world’s on-demand working capital platform, providing fast, flexible and equitable access to low-cost capital to nearly 2 million businesses worldwide. 

Using patented Name Your Rate® technology and a suite of working capital solutions, companies can get paid sooner by the world’s largest enterprises — unlocking billions in risk-free capital. C2FO’s mission is to ensure that every business has the capital needed to thrive and has delivered more than $275 billion in funding around the world.

Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Kansas City, USA, with offices around the globe, C2FO is working to build a better, more inclusive financial system every day.

productsAndServices.description: A digital early-payment marketplace that lets suppliers request payment on approved invoices before their contractual due dates by selecting invoices and setting a discount rate or APR.
productsAndServices.name: C2FO Early Pay™

productsAndServices.description: A buyer-facing supplier-finance platform that supports flexible early-payment programs funded by buyers, financial institutions, C2FO’s funding network, or combinations of these sources.
productsAndServices.name: C2FO Dynamic Supplier Finance

productsAndServices.description: A working-capital advisory and analytics service that evaluates accounts payable, receivables, payment terms, and supplier data to identify and implement cash-flow improvements.
productsAndServices.name: C2FO Working Capital Optimization

productsAndServices.description: A supplier receivables-intelligence platform that consolidates invoice and payment information across buyers and provides analytics on approvals, deductions, payment timing, and cash flow.
productsAndServices.name: C2FO FinanceIQ™

productsAndServices.description: A referral service that matches businesses with vetted third-party lenders offering financing such as receivables finance, term loans, asset-based lending, purchase-order financing, and credit lines.
productsAndServices.name: C2FO Lending Connections

productsAndServices.description: A supplier invoice-management workspace that consolidates invoice records, approval statuses, scheduled payment dates, payment history, and early-payment options across participating buyers.
productsAndServices.name: Invoice Central

aiResearchSummary.text: C2FO is researching systems and methods for dynamically discounting trade debt through forward auctions, as described in Dynamic discounting system and method, enabling sellers to auction inventory to multiple bidders. Additional work includes facilitating dynamic resource management and reconciliation, as well as rerouting resources for management platforms, focusing on suspending and modifying events tied to resource indicators in data files. These areas reflect efforts in optimizing working capital and resource management.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $30,724,904, or 5.41% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,319,702 to $1,721,508,562, a 129.25x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 62 (-11 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (+5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
